event: Original CMIA enactment — § 56.35 compensatory and punitive damages provision established
source: California State Archives / California Legislative Information
url: PENDING — fetch original bill text from California State Archives
key_amendment_citation: Stats. 2013, Ch. 444, Sec. 4 (AB 658) — updated damages provisions
notes: Section 56.35 requires actual harm (economic loss or personal injury) — unlike § 56.36(b)(1) which provides $1,000 nominal damages without proof of actual harm. The two sections operate in parallel: § 56.35 for proven harm; § 56.36 for all violations. Original 1981 text is outstanding work.
